name: VeriFlow Buyer
description: Reference buyer agent for VeriFlow. Before paying, it checks the seller in the Concordium Agent Registry (CIS-8004): badge, Active status, Agent Card hash, and that the x402 payTo is the seller's on-chain agentWallet. It names itself to the seller with the X-Concordium-Agent header; the seller then reads this agent from a Concordium node and accepts the payment only if it comes from this agent's on-chain agentWallet. Testnet only.

skills.name: Buy a verified signal over x402
skills.description: Pays a CIS-8004-registered seller over x402 on Concordium testnet only after verifying it on-chain, and identifies itself as a registered agent.
